watch_item_rules.label: Negative net cash movement
watch_item_rules.why_it_matters: Cash left the business faster than it came in during the review period.

watch_item_rules.label: Large single outgoing transaction
watch_item_rules.why_it_matters: A large payment can create short-term pressure if upcoming inflows are delayed.

watch_item_rules.label: Payroll or debt-service pressure
watch_item_rules.why_it_matters: Required obligations may reduce flexibility for other expenses.

watch_item_rules.label: Duplicate-looking transaction
watch_item_rules.why_it_matters: Possible duplicate records can distort cash-flow analysis.

watch_item_rules.label: Missing balance data
watch_item_rules.why_it_matters: Cash position cannot be confirmed from activity alone.

watch_item_rules.label: Revenue concentration
watch_item_rules.why_it_matters: Dependence on one payer can create volatility if payment timing changes.

watch_item_rules.label: Unclear transfer activity
watch_item_rules.why_it_matters: Transfers can be mistaken for income or expenses if not labeled clearly.
